name: tech-llm-council
description: Pressure-tests a software, infrastructure or SaaS business decision with a council of 5 technical, product and business advisors, anonymous peer review and a chairman verdict. With the separate subq-snap-mcp connector, the SubQ Snap decision model picks each advisor's answer and the chairman's verdict from fixed answer options, improving the options until one is a clear winner; without it the council runs unchanged.
